name: Upcountry Maui: Kula and Olinda on the slope of Haleakala

encoding.grid: linear in longitude/latitude over bbox; sample at cell centres
encoding.resample: 3x3 box average of bilinear samples from the zoom-12 mosaic (native ~36 m/px)

stats.note: Percent of grid cells (sea and lake surface read ~0 m, so they count toward atOrBelowOneMetrePct). The source tiles resolve land to about 1 m; shallow subsidence below that is not visible in this dataset.

water.note: Elevations are metres relative to mean sea level. Negative values are real: land below sea level, and sea/lake bed (terrarium carries bathymetry). The grid has no separate water mask; 0 m is the sea surface.

source.publisher: Mapzen, a Linux Foundation project (dataset "Terrain Tiles", hosted on the Registry of Open Data on AWS)
source.dataset: AWS Terrain Tiles, terrarium encoding (Mapzen joerd; aggregates SRTM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1, USGS 3DEP/NED, EU-DEM and others)
